annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that a server must not include a Content-Range header in the outer HTTP header of a multipart/byteranges response, and that the header will appear in each part instead. The following clause further clarifies that each part must contain a Content-Range header. No alternative reasonable interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
